## Checklist

- [ ] `vendor/bin/pest` passes, and I added tests for what I changed
- [ ] For accounts, permissions, OAuth or logging: I tested what must **not** be possible, not only what works
- [ ] `vendor/bin/pint --test` and `npm run format:check && npx eslint . && npx tsc --noEmit` pass
- [ ] I clicked through any interface change in a browser
- [ ] No secret, token or real server detail is in the code, tests, docs or logs
- [ ] This follows the principles in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) (or explains why it should not)

> Security problems: do not describe them here. Use the repository's **Security** tab ("Report a vulnerability"), see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
